title: Q3 激励在稀缺工况下的替代性
summary: R2 re-solves K=2 at the 0.1% gap on both sides, as the review required. The true pure-truck K=2 gap is 0.0478% (66.1 CNY), below the 199.2 CNY penalty value of the 33.19 unmet trips, so the 1% figure of 134.81 was an upper bound: at 0.1% the pure truck leaves 33.19 zone-level departures unserved at 138,317.15. The least-total hybrid policy at K=2 is arrivals B=30000: it removes 10.40 of the 33.19 at 2,883.3 CNY per removed trip, 480.6x the 6 CNY penalty, and its payment ceiling is -1,591.40 CNY, 11.5x the 0.1% tolerance (138.32). Full coverage is reachable (arrivals B=None, unmet 0.0) only with a 172,327 CNY payment, total 312,289.21 (2.26x the pure-truck cost) and 5,191.6 CNY per removed trip, so it is not a substitute for trucks at any non-negative payment. The R1 claims built on the 1% K=2 plan (112.02 trips at 267.8 CNY, 44.6x, 258 reroutes per trip) are withdrawn and replaced by tight-plan figures (10.40 at 2,883.3, 480.6x, 2,776 reroutes per removed trip); the mechanism baseline is now the tight K=2 plan, whose aligned_share is 0.1590 with 1,405.3 of 28,884.7 reroutes crossing a zone boundary (4.9%). The 'best policy per K' line is corrected: surplus B=30000 at K=0, arrivals B=30000 at K=2/5/10/20. The conclusion is unchanged and now gap-robust: within K in [0,20] the incentive never pays for itself; its value is design and budget discipline.

r2_response.k2_reresolve: K=2 pure re-solved at 0.1%: obj 138,317.15, unmet 33.1936, achieved gap 0.0478% (66.1 CNY). The 809 CNY value of all 33.19 unmet trips is 3.0x the gap value, so the tight solution is not hiding a zero-unmet alternative on the pure-truck side. The 1% figure 134.81 was an upper bound; 0.45% was that solve's achieved gap, not a separate hybrid gap.
r2_response.best_policy: At the tight K=2 baseline the least-total policy is arrivals B=30000: it removes 10.40 of 33.19 unpaid departures, pays 30,000, and its ceiling is -1,591.40 CNY = 11.5x the 0.1% tolerance. Payment per removed trip is 2,883.3 CNY, 480.6x the 6 CNY penalty. The R1 numbers 112.02 / 267.8 / 44.6x are withdrawn; they mixed the 1% K=2 baseline with the old caliper.
r2_response.zero_unmet: The review's alternative 'unmet=0 is cheaper' is now tested explicitly: arrivals B=None drives K=2 truck unmet to 0.0 but costs 172,326.96 in payment, total 312,289.21, 2.26x the pure-truck objective and 5,191.6 CNY per removed trip. It is not cheaper at any non-negative payment, and the payment ceiling stays negative. The mechanism conclusion therefore stands with corrected numbers, not by withdrawal.

notes: K=2 tight pure unmet 33.1936 is neither the coarse 134.8138 nor zero: the 1% solve's 0.84% gap was 1,171 CNY, which exceeded the 809 CNY value of all 134.8 unmet trips, so the review was right that the coarse number could not support the conclusion. At 0.1% the gap value is 66.1 CNY against 199.2 CNY of remaining penalty, and the pure-truck conclusion survives.

The R1 K=2 mechanism claims are withdrawn, not just re-scaled: 112.02 removed / 267.8 CNY / 44.6x / 258 reroutes per trip came from the 1% plan whose own unmet (134.8) is an upper bound. The tight-plan values are 10.40 / 2,883.3 / 480.6x / 2,776 reroutes per removed trip.

Zero unmet is reachable at K=2 only through arrivals B=None: payment 172,326.96, truck objective 139,962.21, total 312,289.21 (2.26x pure), 5,191.6 CNY per removed trip, 865x the penalty. This is the explicit test of the reviewer's alternative and it fails by a wide margin.

At K=5 and K=20 the best-total policy adds 22.79 unmet (it moves arrivals into zone-hours that are already long); it is still the least-bad policy because its payment is smallest. At K=10 the best policy removes the small 0.1936. At K=0 the best is surplus B=30k, not arrivals: 175,123.75 vs 175,220.00.

Mechanism diagnostics: the reroute pattern dA is K-independent (from the PoolLP); only the truck net differs. Under the tight K=2 plan aligned_share is 0.1590, cross-zone bikes 1,405.25 of 28,884.65 (4.9%), imbalance 60,921.3 -> 60,474.5. The 'at most 870 reroutes per unmet trip buy one removal' reading is the right scale statement: even full alignment of the reroute pattern cannot move more than the LP's q.

72 hybrid rows: 40 coarse (all 7 K in {0,2,5,10,20,40,60} x 8 policies, as R0) plus 32 tight (K=2/5/10/20 x 8). Rows carry gap_mode and gap; tight rows use the pure-truck 0.1% objective as the baseline, coarse rows the 1% objective.
